gloss: swirling dust; dust cloud; sandy dust

definitions.gloss: swirling dust; cloud of fine sand or dust particles
definitions.explanation: Fine particles of sand or dust suspended or swirling in the air, typically raised by wind, vehicles, or activity on dry ground.

examples.japanese: {砂|すな}ぼこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧。
examples.english: Dust swirled up into the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事現場|こうじげんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{砂|すな}ぼこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどかった→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: Walking near the construction site, the dust was terrible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{砂|すな}ぼこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{込|こ}め、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind raised a cloud of dust, making it hard to see ahead.

notes:
Combines ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧ (sand) and ぼこり (⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧, dust). Refers specifically to airborne particles of sand or grit, as opposed to indoor household dust (ほこり/ちり).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂|すな}ぼこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がる→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧: dust swirls up
- {砂|すな}ぼこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: dust rises
- {砂|すな}ぼこり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧あびる: to get covered in dust

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{埃|ほこり}→埃：03624_hokori⟧: dust (general) — indoor dust, everyday grime
- ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧: sand — the material itself, not airborne
